description: Fictional demo eligibility rules authored from Example State Admission Handbook 2026-27.

rules.title: Direct Second Year Diploma (DSE) Admission for ITI Holders
caveats: Subject to seat availability in mapped branch
Candidate must verify institute approval with state board
Centralized admission rounds and document verification apply

all.quote: A candidate who has passed the Class X examination
and holds a Two-Year Craft Certificate
shall be eligible for Direct Second Year admission to a Diploma in a Mapped Branch

rules.title: Lateral Entry to Second Year B.Tech / B.E. for Diploma Holders
caveats: Entrance test or normalization may apply per state rules
Subject to seat availability under lateral entry quota (up to 10% supernumerary)

all.quote: A candidate holding a Diploma in Engineering and Technology
with at least 45% marks in aggregate (40% in case of reserved category candidates)
in an appropriate branch of engineering

rules.title: Direct Degree Entry Prohibited for ITI Standalone
caveats: ITI graduates must first complete Diploma via DSE before qualifying for lateral entry B.Tech

all.quote: Holders of National Trade Certificates (ITI) without a recognised Polytechnic Diploma shall not be admitted directly to Bachelor of Technology or Bachelor of Engineering programmes.
